column1: TABLE 1. Betz cell and pyramidal cell numbers and volumes

The raw data from the stereologic analysis of each case are shown, as well as the mean, standard deviations (SD), coefficients of variation (CV), and coefficients of error (CE). The Betz percentage represents the proportion of Betz cells from the total number of layer Vb pyramidal neurons in the primary motor cortex (top). The ratio of Betz cell volume to pyramidal cell volume was calculated to compare the cellular volumes of these two distinct populations of neurons (bottom).
